kickoff.centreCircle.source: FA Mini-Soccer Handbook 2026/27, Law 8 (only a centre mark is described)

kickoff.afterGoalWhichTeam.source: Not stated in the mini-soccer handbook. Do not test the child on this.

kickoff.kickerTouchTwice.source: Not stated in the mini-soccer handbook. Do not test the child on this.

goal.width.source: FA Mini-Soccer Handbook 2026/27, 5v5 goal 12 ft by 6 ft

goalKick.retreatLine.source: FA Mini-Soccer Handbook 2026/27, retreat line (under-7 to under-11): at a goal kick the other team goes back into its own half until the ball is in play. See docs/research/phase1-rules-design-products.md.

goalKick.whenCanCross.source: Exactly when the other team may cross the line (as the ball is kicked, or once a player receives it) waits for Rich's club rule set. Told as 'wait until their keeper has passed it', never tested.

kickIn.type.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 15 'Pass or dribble-in', U7 to U10; also FA Standard Code of Rules 2026-27, Section 30, Rule 20 (sideline restarts: pass in or dribble in). No throw-ins.

kickIn.fromWhereItWentOut.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 15 'Pass or dribble-in', U7 to U10; also FA Standard Code of Rules 2026-27, Section 30, Rule 20 (sideline restarts: pass in or dribble in): 'The ball must be stationary on the touchline at the point where it left the pitch'.

kickIn.opponentDistance.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 15 'Pass or dribble-in', U7 to U10; also FA Standard Code of Rules 2026-27, Section 30, Rule 20 (sideline restarts: pass in or dribble in): 'All opponents must stand at least 5 yards from the point on the touchline'.

kickIn.canScoreDirect.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 15 'Pass or dribble-in', U7 to U10; also FA Standard Code of Rules 2026-27, Section 30, Rule 20 (sideline restarts: pass in or dribble in): 'A goal cannot be scored directly from a pass-in.'

kickIn.kickerTouchTwice.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 15 'Pass or dribble-in', U7 to U10; also FA Standard Code of Rules 2026-27, Section 30, Rule 20 (sideline restarts: pass in or dribble in): 'A kicker taking a pass-in may choose to touch the ball again'.

corner.opponentDistance.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 17 'Corner kicks': 'The defending players must remain at least 5 yards from the ball until it is in play'.

corner.kickerTouchTwice.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 17 'Corner kicks': 'The player taking the corner may not touch the ball again until it has touched another player.'

corner.canScoreDirect.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 17 'Corner kicks' does not say. Do not test the child on it.

penalty.markDistance.source: The handbook gives no penalty mark distance for 5v5. Rich asked for a sensible guess (27th November 2026). Not tested: the spot is drawn for her.

penalty.othersOutsideArea.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 14 'Penalty kicks': 'All players except the defending goalkeeper and kicker must be outside the penalty area and at least 5 yards from the penalty mark.'

penalty.othersDistance.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 14 'Penalty kicks': 'at least 5 yards from the penalty mark'.

penalty.kickedForward.source: FA Mini-Soccer and Youth Futsal Handbook (August 2025), Law 14 'Penalty kicks': 'The ball must be kicked forward.'
